name: Bonus Doubler 4
description: Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X during combat (X = highest Bonus on respective stat among unit and allies within 2 spaces).

name: Atk/Spd Pledge
description: At start of turn, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit for 1 turn. During combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per attack.

name: Godlike Reflexes
description: Reduces damage from foe's attack by 40%. Boosts damage dealt by 15% of Speed.
